name: Hoplight brand tokens
authority: This file is generated from the production stylesheet on every build and scripts/verify.sh fails if the served copy has drifted from it. It supersedes any hand-kept extraction, including the tokens section of the Hoplight brand file in the design reference, which was extracted on 2026-06-02 and still carries the palette retired by commit a0fe4b2.

retired.note: Present only so a session that finds these values in an old file knows they are dead, in either notation. The rgba forms are how this pair survived a fix aimed straight at it.

ink.role: Primary. Headlines, body text, dark section grounds.

ink-mid.role: Dark section step, one level up from ink.

ink-soft.role: Muted ink for supporting prose on light.

gold.role: Accent. Rules, left borders, the one filled button, link underlines. Never dominant.

gold-hot.role: Brighter gold, for large figures on dark grounds only.

gold-deep.role: The gold for small text on light. 5.6:1 on --surface; --gold itself is 2.4:1 and fails.

gold-bg.role: Gold tint for a filled callout ground.

gold-bg-light.role: Lighter gold tint, table and row wash.

white.role: True white, for cards that must separate from --surface.

stone-deep.role: Secondary text that has to pass AA on --surface.

danger.role: Error and destructive state. Semantic only.

line.note: Hairlines. Black alphas on light grounds, white alphas on dark ones.

type.source: globals.css :root and its element rules. Not the brand file, which names a font this repo does not load.

body.role: Everything that is read. One family at every size.
body.stack: var(--font-inter), -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

mono.role: Labels, kickers, units, figures that sit in a column. The only second voice.
mono.installed: JetBrains Mono, via next/font/google in src/app/layout.tsx

scale.note: Fluid clamp() ramps, not a fixed modular scale. Weight 700 and letter-spacing -0.025em on every heading.

numerals.rule: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums on every figure and every column of numbers.
numerals.source: design reference foundation rules, applied throughout globals.css

rules: Left-aligned throughout. No centred body text. No justified text.
More vertical space above a heading than below it.
alignment.source: Hoplight brand file section 2, alignment rules. Not expressible in a stylesheet.

components.source: globals.css element and class rules, parsed. These are the live specs, not the brand file's.

accent rule.rule: The primary separator. Gold is an accent and never dominant: one accent zone per viewport.

callout.rule: Left gold border, no box. Used for the one line that carries the section.

label.spec: font-family var(--font-mono), font-size 0.75rem, text-transform uppercase, letter-spacing 0.14em, color var(--gold-deep)
label.rule: Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked, deep gold. Never at body size.

button, primary.spec: background var(--gold), color var(--ink), height 44px, radius 4px
button, primary.rule: Exactly one filled button above the fold.

focus ring.rule: Visible keyboard focus on every interactive element. Never removed.

prose link.rule: Inline links carry a static gold underline, never hover-only.

divider.spec: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.10) on light, 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10) on dark
divider.rule: Bottom borders only on tables. No full grid.

voice.source: Hoplight brand file section 4, carried verbatim. Nothing here is inferred.
rules: Precise. Name the mechanism. Name the number.
Direct. Lead with the answer. Context follows.
Grounded. Write from inside the work, not above it. Practitioner voice.
Honest about limits. State what the thing does and what it does not do.
tone markers: No em dashes anywhere in rendered output. Hyphens, commas, colons, periods.
No tidy parallel constructions. Break into separate sentences.
State what is unknown rather than implying certainty.

not carried: Logo files. The brand file records none as existing.
A tagline. The brand file says none is formalised; the positioning line is "AI strategy for labor, advocacy, and mission-driven organizations".
The brand file's docx and pptx implementation sections. They are document specs, not web tokens, and nothing on this site consumes them.
The brand file's GT America type scale and its 17px / Perfect Fourth document scale. The stylesheet is authoritative on type and runs Inter at 15.5px with clamp() ramps.
